name: hcapp_logAppError
description: Logs a client-side app error to HC.AppError. No authentication check — any caller can write to this table without a valid token.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Device UUID. Stored in AppError but NOT used to look up or validate the caller.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Auth token. Accepted but never validated — dead parameter.

parameters.name: httpBody
parameters.description: HTTP request body at the time of the error. Optional.

parameters.name: errorText
parameters.description: The error message or stack trace from the client.

parameters.name: extraData
parameters.description: Additional context JSON or text. Optional.

sideEffects: INSERT INTO HC.AppError (DeviceId, HttpBody, ErrorText, ExtraData)

codeSmells.issue: No authentication — @accessToken accepted but never validated
codeSmells.detail: Any unauthenticated caller can write arbitrary data to HC.AppError. This is a write endpoint with no auth guard whatsoever, enabling log injection or table bloat attacks.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
